title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 — Up, Up and a Koopa
The Mushroom Kingdom is sent into the sky.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E9 — Mush-Rumors; The Ugly Mermaid
Humans are lost in the Mushroom Kingdom; the brothers enter an underwater kingdom.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E12 — True Colors; Recycled Koopa
King Koopa tricks the Mushroom people; junk is dumped into the Mushroom Kingdom.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E5 — Sing for the Unicorn
Link plans an attempt at romancing Zelda by swinging into her window from above by a rope; the attempt is interrupted as Ganon rides a flying unicorn over the castle and kidnaps the king for ransom.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E6 — That Sinking Feeling
A giant magnet pulls the castle underground along with the king and Sprite.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E8 — Underwold Connections
Link sleepwalks middle of the night and unconsciously sneaks toward Zelda's room; Zelda sees his approach and wakes him in time to see gargoyle-like Vires attack and try to steal the Triforce of Wisdom.

title: Scary Godmother: The Revenge of Jimmy
description:
S1
Hannah must stop Jimmy from erasing Halloween from the calendar.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E6 — Pac-Mania
Pac enjoys being a celebrity until a TV show based on him, Cyli and Spiral make them look silly.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E7 — Rip Van Packle
Pac tries to locate the Pointy Planet and his parents.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E8 — Spooka-Bazooka!
Betrayus comes up with a plot to conquer PacWorld.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E6 — The Price of Deceit
Skeletor tries to banish Evil-Lyn to another dimension for betraying him in favor of the Snake Men.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E7 — Of Machines and Men
A mysterious force disables all technological power in Eternia.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E8 — Second Skin
He-Man desperately tries to stop King Hiss from using a devastatingly powerful ancient artifact that will grant him immense power.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S2 E17 — Bearded Ambition
After seeing a statue of his forefather with a beard, King Pig decides he wants a beard too.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S2 E21 — Eating Out
The birds are forced to fend for themselves when Matilda's at the beach.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E49 — A Secret Worth Keeping: Part One
It's Talking Angela's birthday and the guys have planned a big surprise party for her, but when Talking Tom gets the directions wrong, they end up in the hot desert instead of picking up dessert.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1
Armed with tech gear, ideas and an unfailing sense of humor, Talking Tom and his friends are on a mission to reach stardom at all costs.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E46 — Holy Rabbid-Cow!
In the country, a fly fascinates two Rabbids; after unintentionally crushing it in an empty can, they decide to go and catch some of the ones flying around a cow.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E49 — Hypno Rabbid
The Chief Rabbid invents new tasks for the Rabbids; finding a disk with a spiral on it, he makes his troops fan him by making it spin, but ends up hypnotized; the other Rabbids take advantage of this and reverse roles.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E13 — The Venice Menace; Super Koopa
Venice is under siege; Kooky Von Koopa makes a magic pendant.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 — Sneaky Lying Cheating Giant Ninja Koopas
Ninja Koopas try to turn a prince into a dog.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E7 — Doppelganger
Ganon plots to get the Triforce of Wisdom by using a magic mirror to create an evil double of Zelda.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E9 — Stinging a Stinger
Link interrupts a highway bandit mugging a peddler named Sleazenose on the path, and to express his gratitude, he gives a jeweled sword to Link and takes his old sword off his hands.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E10 — Hitch in the Works
Since there's little activity from Ganon's minions, the Princess assigns chores to Link.

A young girl experiences trick-or-treating and her cousin's pranks.
